args.title: Introducing CSV Export: Take Your Reports Anywhere
args.body:
We're excited to announce that CSV export is now available — and it's coming to all of you.

Starting Tuesday 12 November, every plan can export any of their reports as a CSV file. No more copying data between tabs or waiting on manual downloads — your reports are ready to take wherever you need them.

How it works
- Head to Reports → Export.
- Pick the report you'd like to export.
- Download it as a CSV file.

Every export includes all the columns currently shown in the report, so you get exactly the data you're looking at — nothing missing, nothing extra.

What you can do with it
- Load your data into spreadsheets for deeper analysis.
- Feed reports into your own dashboards and tools.
- Share clean, structured data with teammates or clients.

Whether you're a solo user or running a team, CSV export gives you full control over your reporting data.

Available now on all plans from Tuesday 12 November. Happy exporting!

- **Phone (Saturdays):** 9 am – 1 pm, starting 30 November
- **Phone (Weekdays):** No change to current hours
- **Live chat:** Available around the clock, every day

Thanks for being part of our community — happy weekend building!

args.title: Announcing CSV Export for All Reports
args.body:
We're excited to announce that **CSV export** is now available for all plans!

Starting **Tuesday, 12 November**, you can export any report as a CSV file directly from your dashboard.

## What's new

- **Export any report as CSV** – Head to **Reports → Export** and pick the report you'd like to download.
- **All plans, no exceptions** – Whether you're on our Starter, Pro, or Enterprise plan, CSV export is included at no extra cost.
- **Full column coverage** – Your export will include every column currently shown in the report, so nothing gets left behind.

## Why we built it

You asked, we listened. Many of you have been pulling data into spreadsheets, BI tools, or other downstream systems, and a native export option makes that workflow faster and less error-prone. With CSV export, you can grab exactly what you're seeing on screen and drop it straight into Excel, Google Sheets, a data warehouse, or any tool that accepts a CSV.

## Getting started

1. Navigate to **Reports**.
2. Select the report you want to export.
3. Click **Export** and choose **CSV**.
4. Save the file to your device.

That's it—no extra setup, no API keys, no waiting for a support ticket.

## Questions or feedback?

If you run into any issues or have ideas for how we can improve exports (think: scheduled exports, larger date ranges, or additional formats), drop us a line via the in-app feedback form or reply to this post. We read everything.

Happy exporting!

— The Product Team
